feature_families.description: Daily return, range, moving-average, volatility, downside volatility, distribution-shape, liquidity, and Amihud-style state variables.
feature_families.information_set_legality: Uses current and prior daily bars only; rolling windows are trailing by stock and end at trade_date.
not_for: factor-specific nonlinear transforms that are cheap and used once
training-time normalization fitted on IS only
feature_families.reasoning: Broad reuse, low storage cost, and common Step3/Step4 controls make this the first daily feature datamart candidate.

feature_families.description: Qlib Alpha360-style 60-lag OHLCV/VWAP tensor normalized by current price or volume.
feature_families.information_set_legality: Uses current and prior daily bars only; no future dates or label-side normalization in the datamart.
not_for: manual factor formulas that only need a few lags
researchers loading all 360 columns without projection
feature_families.reasoning: Useful as standardized model-ready temporal context, especially for tree/deep models, but wide and heavier than engineered daily state.

feature_families.description: Cutoff-time intraday return, amount, signed-flow, HHI, entropy, skewness, kurtosis, tail asymmetry, and large/small proxy states.
feature_families.information_set_legality: Each cutoff row uses only minute rows with trade_time <= cutoff_time; large/small thresholds use prior-date rolling history.
not_for: true order-flow imbalance without tick or order data
full-day features used before market close
feature_families.reasoning: This is a high-reuse sufficient-statistics layer for moneyflow, microstructure, terminal-shape, and liquidity-regime factors.

feature_families.description: Cutoff-time compact state pack for intraday return, volume, amount, volatility, drawdown, terminal return, and liquidity state.
feature_families.information_set_legality: Each cutoff state uses only trade_time <= cutoff_time; no full-day aggregation unless cutoff is market close.
not_for: factor formulas requiring raw minute sequence
features with unstable researcher-specific window definitions
feature_families.reasoning: Many minute factors repeatedly rebuild the same basic cutoff states; precomputing the compact pack reduces IO and boilerplate.

feature_families.description: Terminal-window correlation and co-movement states such as price-volume correlation, signed-volume correlation, and terminal reversal/acceleration summaries.
feature_families.information_set_legality: Terminal windows must end at or before cutoff_time and never inspect future intraday minutes.
not_for: raw minute factors with custom nonlinear path transforms
cross-sectional neutralization performed after feature production
feature_families.reasoning: CPV-like factors showed repeated cost in terminal correlation scans; direct-array kernels plus per-stock map-reduce make this a reusable state candidate.

feature_families.description: Recursive slow-state features such as exponentially smoothed score history, event memory, and lambda-state accumulators.
feature_families.information_set_legality: State recursion must carry previous chunk final state or use explicit warmup with discarded warmup metrics; no independent yearly reset can be claimed full-window.
not_for: one-off alpha formulas with no reuse
feature_families.reasoning: State recursion is hard for researchers to implement safely in ad hoc Step4 code; it belongs in Data API once the source score datamart is accepted.

feature_families.description: Pseudo dollar/event buckets derived from 1-minute bars rather than tick prints.
feature_families.information_set_legality: Only buckets completed before cutoff_time may be used for cutoff signals; the dataset must be labeled pseudo from 1m bars, not true tick dollar bars.
not_for: claims about true tick dollar bars
production before research demand and cost are clear
feature_families.reasoning: Potentially useful for event-time models, but cost and conceptual ambiguity are higher than cutoff sufficient statistics.

feature_families.description: Cross-sectional ranks, z-scores, neutralized residuals, and universe-relative transforms.
feature_families.information_set_legality: Cross-sectional transforms must be computed after applying the relevant universe and tradability filters for the same trade_date.
not_for: global factual datamart shared across incompatible universes
precomputed values before final universe/investability filters
feature_families.reasoning: These transforms depend on the chosen universe, industry map, neutralization controls, and research split; storing one global version is usually misleading.

notes: This registry describes feature families, not active Data API datasets.
Precompute broad and medium-reuse sufficient statistics; keep universe-dependent cross-sectional transforms on the research side.
Alpha360 is treated as standardized temporal context, not as a mandatory global feature table for every workflow.
